spec.description: Site-to-site link monitor (UDP echo probes). Latency panels (Current RTT, Percentiles, Average, Jitter) are RTT in ms, derived from link_rtt_seconds (seconds) via histogram_quantile/rate; they gap during outages. Packet Loss = 100 * rate(link_probes_timed_out_total)/rate(link_probes_sent_total) — true network loss (UDP never retransmits), reading ~100% during a full outage; a shorter rate window catches shorter outages. The server-side link_server_probes_received_total is a cross-check on the client's sent counter.
Probe timeout in use over time (ms). Rises on consecutive timeouts so loss detection recovers from latency jumps; floor tracks 2x smoothed RTT.
spec.title: Adaptive RTO (history)

spec.description: Smoothed RFC3550 jitter in ms, resets after gap (sequence loss). Instant gauge, not windowed.
spec.title: Jitter

spec.description: Largest DF-set frame that round-trips (header+payload bytes; +28 for IP/UDP overhead vs interface MTU). 0 = never discovered. A drop here while link_up stays 1 is the works-small-fails-big signature (VPN MTU shrink, PMTUD breakage).
spec.title: Path MTU (DF-probed)

spec.description: DF-set sweep probes with no echo per second (MTU search probes that exceed the path). Sustained non-zero loss with healthy main probes = fragmentation-requiring traffic is blackholed.
spec.title: DF Probe Loss

spec.description: Echoes whose payload failed the byte-pattern check (-payload mode): data-path corruption, NOT loss — the round trip completed.
spec.title: Corruption %

spec.description: Probes failing to leave the host (UDP write errors): NIC/socket problem, not network loss. Sustained rate here while link_up drops means a local fault, not the link.
spec.title: Send Errors (local)

spec.description: Every link_up transition within the selected time range, with timestamp and the resulting state. Annotations on the other panels mark the same transitions.
spec.title: Link State Changes

spec.expr: count(link_up{target=~"$target", source=~"$source"} == 0) or count(absent_over_time(link_up{target=~"$target", source=~"$source"}[10m])) or vector(0)

spec.description: Count of monitored links currently showing link_up = 0 after the 3-miss threshold. 1 = everything absent (monitor itself is gone). Per-source absences show in 'Monitors missing (now)'.
spec.title: Links Down (now)

spec.description: Server-side and prober-internal counters. They cross-check the client-side panels above; none of them feed the loss ratio or the sent/rtt/timed_out balance.
spec.title: Server & prober health

options.content: Server-side, prober-internal and endpoint counters — cross-checks on the panels above, not link-quality signals.

spec.description: Probes written but not yet echoed or timed out (link_probes_inflight). Rises while the link stalls; if it stays pinned while RTT and timeout rates are both flat, the probe loop is stuck.
spec.title: Probes In Flight

spec.description: Probes the echo server rejected per second, by reason (link_server_probes_dropped_total). hmac/replay mean a secret or clock-skew misconfig, rate_ip/rate_global mean overload, allowlist means a topology change — none of these is network loss.
spec.title: Server Probes Dropped

spec.description: Server clock minus the client probe timestamp, per client (link_server_clock_skew_seconds). Within 5s of the ±30s replay window, valid probes start being dropped as replays; resynchronize NTP.
spec.title: Server Clock Skew

spec.description: Validated probes received by the server per second, by client (link_server_probes_received_total). Cross-check against the client-side link_probes_sent_total: a persistent gap is probes that never arrived, or ones the server failed to echo.
spec.title: Server Probes Received

spec.description: Prober-internal failures per second, by reason (link_prober_internal_errors_total: panic, reader_dead, dial_retry, stop_timeout). Not link conditions — while these move, this target's probe numbers are unreliable.
spec.title: Prober Internal Errors

spec.description: Validated probes the server failed to echo, per second (link_server_echo_errors_total, a local UDP write failure). The client counts these as loss, so subtract this rate before blaming the network for a sent/received mismatch.
spec.title: Server Echo Errors

spec.description: Rejected HTTP Basic auth attempts on /metrics and /status per second (link_metrics_auth_failures_total). A rising rate is a misconfigured scraper or credential scanning against the monitor itself, not a link fault.
spec.title: Metrics Auth Failures

spec.description: Sources with a firing LinkMonitorAbsent / LinkMonitorSourceAbsent / LinkScrapeTargetDown alert: the prober stopped exporting (dead agent, unreachable /metrics, broken scrape). This is the down signal a stale link_up series cannot show.
spec.title: Monitors missing (now)

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (source, target, le) (rate(link_rtt_seconds_bucket{source=~"$source", target=~"$target"}[5m]))) * 1000

clamp_max(100 * sum by (source, target) (rate(link_probes_timed_out_total{source=~"$source", target=~"$target"}[5m])) / sum by (source, target) (rate(link_probes_sent_total{source=~"$source", target=~"$target"}[5m])), 100)

spec.description: Fleet overview: one row per source→target link with current link_up, p50 RTT (ms), jitter (ms), packet loss (%) and DF-probed path MTU (bytes). Uses the same five-minute windows as the individual panels.
spec.title: Fleet overview — all links

spec.description: RTT percentiles (p50/p90/p99) over a 5-minute window in ms, where gaps indicate outages. p50 reflects typical median performance, while p90 and p99 highlight tail latency and worst-case outliers that standard averages hide.
spec.title: Tail Latency (p99)

spec.description: Packet loss % over time, 5-minute window: 100 * rate(timed_out)/rate(sent). Reads ~100% during a full outage. Pick a rate window >= the outage you want to see as a full 100% block.
spec.title: Packet Loss (history)

spec.description: Mean RTT over a 5-minute window, in ms: rate(sum)/rate(count). Gaps = outage.
spec.title: Average Latency

spec.description: Connection state over time: 1 = up, 0 = down after 3 consecutive missed probes. Cross-reference with Packet Loss (100% while down). NO DATA (3) = the source stopped exporting; the line ends where the series went stale.
spec.title: Link Status (history)

spec.description: Probes per second: rate(link_probes_sent_total). Probes are always sent at the interval cadence — even into a down link, where they time out and read as 100% loss.
spec.title: Probe Throughput
Link Monitor

spec.description: Logical source/site label of the link; separates sites that share one scrape instance
spec.label: Source
spec.name: source
